expectations.text: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
expectations.evidence: "this is over-split for what it is, and I'd consolidate. The fact that you use AI assistants heavily is actually an argument against this layout, not for it."

expectations.text: Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
expectations.evidence: "Collapse it to one or two files... UserBadge.tsx # types + logic + JSX together."

expectations.text: Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell (cross-file context the agent won't fetch)
expectations.evidence: Mentions 'hallucinate a prop that doesn't line up across types.ts and .logic.ts' and that split files 'tell the agent very little' alone, but frames it as context-assembly/sync cost rather than the specific reluctance to fetch a sibling that shapes a dumb view's props.

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely isolatable styles as a defensible separate file (does not blanket-merge everything)
expectations.evidence: "Keep styles separate only if your styling system forces it (e.g. a .module.scss companion) — and a CSS/SCSS module is a fine exception because it's a different language and tooling."
